name: Related
description: Any other link, when none of the other types fits. Label and description are required.

relation.example: ring.relate(grandmother, "related", label="inherited from", description="passed down in 2019")
relation.reads: the ring is what Michael inherited from his grandmother

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: What the user calls this relation, in their words.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: What this link is, in a sentence.
